newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Press office says Yeltsin working in Barvikha.
newsitem.headline: Press office says Yeltsin working in Barvikha.

text.p: The press office of Russian President Boris Yeltsin, clearly annoyed at rumours in world financial markets that Yeltsin was dead, said on Wednesday that Yeltsin was working at the Barvikha sanatorium outside Moscow.

"This is another example of how people use the situation surrounding the president's health for their own purposes," press service head Igor Ignatiev said. "We do not even see a need to comment on rumours like this. Yeltsin's condition is satisfactory. He is at Barvikha."

Yeltsin, 65, moved to the Barvikha sanatorium last weekend after spending over three weeks in hospital while doctors prepare him for an operation to improve blood supply to his heart. The surgery is due within the next two months.
The rumours, from London, New York and other financial centres, came on a day when news that the president had moved to Barvikha was sending Russian share prices sharply higher.
Share volume on the Russian Trading System hit a record high volume of $46.97 million on Wednesday.

The president met Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin in Barvikha on Tuesday. His press office issued a statement on border policies on Wednesday in which Yeltsin said Russia had no territorial claims on other countries.
